tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: The desktop ground the whole console sits on, behind every widget. Never put small text directly on it; widgets carry text.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Default widget and panel body. The standard ground for ink, ink-muted and ink-faint.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised bands inside a widget: its header bar, the Dock, table header rows, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: the Terminal body, text inputs, the LogStream scroll area. Darker than surface-100 in dark, so a well reads as cut into the panel.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers and widget outlines at stroke-hairline. Carries no meaning, so it is exempt from the 3:1 floor; it stays visible on surface-100 and surface-200 both.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: control outlines, the focused widget edge, ProcessTable column rules. Holds 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and readout numerals. Reads on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and every -wash token at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: widget subtitles, axis labels, table headers, units beside a readout. Reads on all four surfaces at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text held to a real 4.5:1: log timestamps, PID columns, placeholder text. Reads on all four surfaces in both themes. Not a disabled color; use opacity-disabled for that.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The identity accent and the console's amber: the active Dock item, the focused widget's header rule, the one number a screen is about. Reads as text on all four surfaces in both themes. Spend it on one thing per screen.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis amber ground: the active Dock item's fill, a hovered row, the selected tab. Carries ink at 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid signal fill, such as a primary Button. Flips per theme because signal is light in dark and dark in light; never hard-code white on signal.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Interactive text and the focus ring's hue: links, a sortable ProcessTable header, a clickable unit name in a log line. Reads on all four surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Nominal state: a healthy StatusDot, a thermal reading under its warn threshold, an active systemd unit. Always paired with a word or glyph, never color alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: First threshold crossed: a thermal zone over its warn mark, memory over 75%, a degraded link. Always paired with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: serious
tokens.usage: Second threshold: sustained thermal throttling, a filesystem over 90%. Sits between warn and critical in both hue and lightness so the three are told apart without hue alone.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Failure needing attention now: a dead unit, a link down, a zone at its trip point. Always paired with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for an ok Badge and the nominal band of a ThermalGauge track. Carries ink at 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for a warn Badge and the warn band of a ThermalGauge track. Carries ink at 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: critical-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for a critical Badge, a failed log row and the trip band of a ThermalGauge track. Carries ink at 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First categorical slot, fixed to cpu-thermal on this device. Assign slots in order and never cycle; a chart keeps a series on its slot when other series are filtered out.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical slot, fixed to gpu-thermal. Holds at least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical slot, fixed to ve-thermal (the video engine). Holds at least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical slot, fixed to ddr-thermal. The set stops at four: a fifth measure goes in its own chart, never a generated hue.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and baselines, and the 2px gap between adjacent fills. Recessive by design: it sits just off surface-100 and must never compete with a mark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The solid 2px keyboard focus ring at stroke-focus, offset 2px. Holds at least 3:1 on all four surfaces in both themes. Never remove it; never replace it with a shadow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimming layer behind a drawer, a dialog or a full-size picture, drawn at opacity-scrim. Dark in both themes: it dims whatever is behind it, and a light scrim only fogs it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The console name on the cover and the login screen. Not used inside widgets.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Widget header title and screen headings. Set in ink.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: The line under a widget title naming its source, such as a sysfs path. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Prose, help text and Button labels. Set in ink on surface-100.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field and axis labels, table headers, StatTile captions. Set in ink-muted; apply uppercase in CSS, not in the copy.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The smallest label that still reads: Badge text, gauge tick numbers. Reserve for glanceable single words.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a widget: a zone temperature, load average, uptime. Tabular figures so a live value does not reflow.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Secondary numerals: a StatTile value in a dense row, a MeterBar percentage.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Identifiers that must stay monospaced: zone names, interface names, unit names, PIDs.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal input and output, and inline commands in prose. Set in ink on surface-300.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: LogStream rows. Tight leading so more lines fit the widget; timestamps in ink-faint, message in ink.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. space-0.5 exists only for the 2px separations charts need.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: The surface gap between adjacent fills and the ring on an overlapping mark. Also the focus ring's offset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label, StatusDot to text, Badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Dense row padding: LogStream rows, ProcessTable cells, Button padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Widget header padding and the gap between widgets in the dashboard grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard widget body padding. The default inset for anything inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Separation between widget groups on the main screen, and a widget body that holds a single hero readout.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margin around the dashboard grid, above the Dock.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Dock height, and the space above a screen heading.

radius.note: Small radii: this is an instrument panel, not a consumer card stack.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Terminal wells, table cells, chart bars, anything that should read as machined rather than soft.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, Badges, the rounded data-end of a MeterBar fill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Widget panels and the Dock. The default panel radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces only: popovers, the app launcher, a dragged widget.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: StatusDot, the Dock's active indicator, gauge track caps.

shadow.note: Elevation is carried by surface steps and hairline first; shadow only lifts what genuinely floats.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Every widget at rest. A dashboard of shadowed cards reads as noise.

tokens.name: shadow-widget
tokens.usage: The dragged or focused widget only, to separate it from the widget it passes over.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, the app launcher and context menus at radius-lg.

stroke.note: Mark and border widths. Charts read at 2px; borders at 1px.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider drawn in hairline or hairline-strong.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Chart lines, Sparkline paths and gauge arcs. Thin enough to stay data, thick enough to read on surface-300.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The solid focus-ring outline, offset by space-0.5.

tokens.name: stroke-cap
tokens.usage: The rounded data-end radius on a bar or MeterBar fill, anchored at the baseline end only.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled Button or an inactive Dock item. Never the only cue: also set aria-disabled.

tokens.name: opacity-wash
tokens.usage: A hover tint over a row when no -wash token fits, laid over the row's own ground.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind the app launcher, over surface-000.
